name: Chat Thread
description: A monochrome, document-style AI chat: the thread staggers in, replies stream in chunks that settle like ink, grey-highlighted code, sources, a real composer.

props.name: messages
props.description: User messages ({ role: "user", text }) and assistant messages ({ role: "assistant", blocks, sources }).

props.name: streamLast
props.description: Stream the final assistant message once the thread has landed.

props.name: reply
props.description: Returns the blocks streamed back after a send. Blocks are paragraphs, lists or code with **bold** and `code` inline.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the text whenever the user sends.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Mono metadata line under the title.

props.name: assistantName
props.description: Assistant name; its first letter becomes the avatar mark.

props.name: onNewThread
props.description: Called by the New thread button. Without it the button clears the thread to an empty state.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the send button and the assistant’s live dot.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root; it fills its parent’s height.
